notes:
Housed in a gatefold jacket, with gold embossed detail on the inside.
The record comes inside a full-color printed inner sleeves, with lyrics for each track.
Includes a insert with musician and art credits, and a sticker with the album logo printed on it.

"Made in Czech Republic", attached to the rear shrink wrap.
Sealed copies come with a circular hype sticker, attached to the front shrink wrap.
Some copies, sold through webstore, come with a signed art card. Barcode attached to the rear shrink wrap.

Tracks numbered sequentially across all sides.

Runouts are machine-engraved and laser-etched.
— In the runouts: GZ Media and PRP IDs, plus 7-digit nickel mother IDs, are machine-engraved. The 8-digit stamper ID is laser-etched.

— Catalog numbers:
"602478840203" on credits insert.
"602478840203" on hype sticker.
"602478840203-1" on inner sleeve 1.
"602478840203-2" on inner sleeve 2.
"00602478840203-B" on center label, side B.
"00602478840203-D" on center label, side D.
"00602478840203" on gatefold spine and back cover.
